Definition: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform
BiblicalUsage: 1) pot, basin, laver, pan; 1a) pot, caldron; 1b) fire-pot, brazier; 1c) basin, laver; 1d) platform, stage
